relayData.description: Two test peers send application bytes over the relay's explicit data lane and check they arrive intact in both directions.
relayData.name: Relay data lane
relayData.phase: Data latency: from sending a test payload over the data lane until the other peer has received and verified it.

signalingAuth.description: Two test peers authenticate into a signaling room over WebSocket and exchange a signal.
signalingAuth.name: Authenticated signaling
signalingAuth.phase: Auth latency: from opening the WebSocket until both peers have authenticated into the test room.

signalingHttp.description: The signaling host answers HTTPS with a valid Cognia health response.
signalingHttp.name: Signaling HTTP
signalingHttp.phase: HTTP latency: time to receive a complete health response over HTTPS.

footer.boundaries: This page reports the official hosted Cognia relay: HTTPS reachability, authenticated signaling and the relay data lane, as measured by the observers listed above. It does not describe self-hosted relays, direct peer-to-peer or TURN connectivity, your own Host, or mobile carrier networks.
footer.description: Get an email when an incident opens, changes or resolves, and when maintenance is scheduled.
footer.measurement: Availability is observed from probe results and always shown with its coverage. It is not a service-level agreement.
footer.title: Know when the relay changes state.
